import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    postings = inputs["POSTINGS"].copy()

    # Preserve cursor ordering: ORDER BY account_id, post_date, post_seq
    df = postings.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "post_date", "post_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to keep deterministic tie behavior
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Row validity check (mirrors the TRY block's reject condition)
    qty = df["qty"]
    price = df["unit_price"]
    valid = qty.notna() & (qty > 0) & price.notna() & (price >= 0)

    df["_valid"] = valid
    df["post_value"] = pd.NA
    df.loc[valid, "post_value"] = df.loc[valid, "qty"] * df.loc[valid, "unit_price"]

    # Build POSTED_TOTALS: only valid rows contribute, running total accumulates
    # only over valid rows per account, in cursor order.
    posted = df.loc[valid, ["account_id", "post_seq", "post_date", "post_value"]].copy()
    posted["post_value"] = posted["post_value"].astype(float)
    posted["running_total"] = posted.groupby("account_id")["post_value"].cumsum()

    posted_totals = posted[
        ["account_id", "post_seq", "post_date", "post_value", "running_total"]
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    # Build REJECT_COUNTS: one row per account that appeared in the cursor,
    # including accounts with zero rejects.
    reject_counts = (
        df.groupby("account_id")["_valid"]
        .apply(lambda s: int((~s).sum()))
        .reset_index(name="reject_count")
    )
    reject_counts["reject_count"] = reject_counts["reject_count"].astype(int)

    return {
        "posted_totals": posted_totals,
        "reject_counts": reject_counts,
    }
